events.title: Returning Western capacity may cap 2027 price increases
events.summary: TiPMC: demand +3.2% in 2027, but Venator restarts, Chinese expansion and weak housing limit pricing power.

analyses.summary: Chinese sulphate-process rutile has fallen back from its April peak as inventories stayed high and domestic demand weak. Western producers pushed several rounds of increases in 2026, but returning European capacity and Chinese chloride expansion are likely to cap further gains in 2027.
